source_fields.audit_event.id: id; source identity, not synthesized domain success
source_fields.audit_event.actor_id + principal.kind/di: Current-authorized display actor; unknown if unavailable
source_fields.audit_event.action + reviewed domain eve: Allowlisted title and disposition; generic actions do not imply success
source_fields.audit_event.target_id + authorized targe: object name/kind and permitted local detail destination
source_fields.reviewed domain payload occurrence time: occurred_at or null; never substitute created_at silently
source_fields.qualified current resource placement: provider or null; no brand inference
source_fields.current purpose-specific qualification: evidence; default Unknown when not independently established

pagination: Authorization and redaction before ordering/filtering/page formation. Generic list_audit_event is not a finished feed query. Bind cursor to current disclosure scope and filters. Report partial results without hidden counts.
event_authority: Source domain records remain authoritative. Do not copy the activity view back as evidence or use it to dispatch.
actor_privacy: Do not expose agent instructions, prompts, secret credentials, knowledge bytes, customer payloads or arbitrary audit payloads. Display names require current disclosure permission.
remaining_states: Authorized server projection and result contract
Cursor signing, revocation and object disclosure tests

recovery_review_example_filter.journey_filter: Applied separately; may yield empty sample feed
recovery_review_example_filter.status: Fixed illustrative events, no live query

time_boundary: Observed source time, received time and definition verification time are separate; display does not qualify evidence.
